description: This is a Java unit test class for the ImmutableSubjects class, testing immutability, equals/hashCode, JSON serialization/deserialization, edge cases, and state modifications.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjectsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableSubjects, verifying immutability, JSON serialization, equality, and behavior under modifications.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableSubjects class is immutable and its 'subjects' field is safely copied and unmodifiable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations of ImmutableSubjects using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: testToAndFromJson
methods.description: Checks JSON serialization and deserialization cycle correctness for ImmutableSubjects.

methods.name: createResourcesWithSamePathsShouldFail
methods.description: Ensures providing duplicate Subject instances to ImmutableSubjects.of throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: setExistingSubjectAgainReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Tests that setting a Subject already contained in ImmutableSubjects returns the same instance.

methods.name: setSubjectReturnsNewExtendedObject
methods.description: Verifies adding a new Subject returns a new ImmutableSubjects with the Subject included.

methods.name: removeSubjectReturnsNewReducedObject
methods.description: Checks that removing a Subject returns a new ImmutableSubjects without the removed Subject.

methods.name: removeNonExistingSubjectReturnsSameObject
methods.description: Ensures removing a non-existing Subject does not change the ImmutableSubjects instance.
